comun.errorGenerico: Something went wrong. Try again; if it keeps happening, contact Administration.

login.errorConexion: We couldn't connect to the server. Check your connection and try again.
login.tengoInvitacion: Have an invitation code? Sign up
login.cuentaDadaDeBaja: Your account has been deactivated. Contact Administration.
login.invitacionEncontradaCuerpo: You can continue your registration where you left it.

registro.dniInvalido: The ID number must have 9 characters.
registro.edadMinima: You must be at least 18 to register.
registro.telefonoInvalido: That number doesn't look valid for {{pais}}. Check the number of digits.
registro.correoYaRegistrado: You already have an account with this email. Log in or recover your password.
registro.genericoConPista: We couldn't create the account. Check that the ID number is the one Administration gave you and that you don't already have an account with another email. If the problem continues, contact Administration.
registro.invitacionNoExiste: We couldn't find that invitation code. Check it or ask Administration for a new one.
registro.invitacionRevocada: That invitation was cancelled. Ask Administration for a new one.
registro.invitacionVencida: That invitation expired. Ask Administration for a new one.
registro.invitacionUsada: That invitation was already used. If you started your registration and didn't finish it, log in with your email and password to confirm the code.
registro.dniBloqueadoAviso: This ID number comes from your invitation and can't be changed here.
registro.avisoRevisaCorreo: Check your email carefully: you won't be able to change it from the app afterwards.

codigo.codigoIncorrectoOVencido: The code is incorrect or expired. Request a new one.
codigo.instruccion: We sent a 6-digit code to {{correo}}. Enter it here to continue.
codigo.reenviado: We sent you a new code. The previous one no longer works.
codigo.confirmadoSinSesion: Your email is confirmed, but we couldn't open your session. Please log in with your email and password.
codigo.correoNoEsElTuyo: Is this not your email? Let Administration know.

jornadasRecuperadas.mensajeSingular: We found an open shift ({{matricula}}, {{ruta}}) this phone didn't have. You can now view and close it like any other.
jornadasRecuperadas.mensajePlural: We found {{cantidad}} open shifts this phone didn't have. You can now view and close them like any other.

jornadasCorregidas.mensajeSingular: An admin corrected {{campos}} on your shift ({{matricula}}, {{ruta}}).
jornadasCorregidas.mensajePlural: An admin corrected {{cantidad}} of your shifts. Open each one's detail to see what changed.

checkIn.subtituloFormulario: Fill in the details before heading out.
checkIn.errorUbicacionMensaje: Check-in needs to record your current location. Please try again.
checkIn.exitoMensaje: Your check-in was recorded. Have a good trip!
checkIn.errorGenerico: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

checkInForm.fotoHojaRutaAyuda: General backup of the route information.

checkOut.vacioTexto: Once you start a route, it will show up here so you can close it.

checkOutForm.kmFinalError: Final mileage can't be less than the starting mileage ({{km}} km).
checkOutForm.notaUbicacion: When you confirm, your current GPS location will be captured automatically as the closing point.
checkOutForm.exitoMensaje: Your check-out was recorded. Rest well!
checkOutForm.exitoMensajeOffline: Your check-out was saved on the device and will be sent automatically once you're back online.
checkOutForm.exitoMensajeSinUbicacion: Your check-out was recorded, but we couldn't capture your location (check your GPS).

incidencias.pregunta: Did you have any incident during the shift?
incidencias.preguntaCheckin: Did you have any incident while loading?
incidencias.detalleError: Details are required for the "Other" type.
incidencias.fotosAyuda: You can attach one or more photos as evidence.

detalleJornada.jornadaEnCurso: This shift is still in progress.
detalleJornada.sincError: There was an upload error, it will retry automatically
detalleJornada.sincNecesitaReintento: Couldn't send after several automatic attempts. Pull down to retry once you have signal, or let your supervisor know if it keeps happening.

capturaFoto.permisoMensaje: Enable camera access in Settings to attach the photo.

galeria.avisoTitulo: Save a copy of your photos
galeria.avisoMensaje: Photos you take in the app will also be saved to this phone's gallery, as a copy for you. If your phone backs photos up to Google Photos or iCloud, these will be backed up there too. You can delete them from the gallery whenever you want; the copy the company receives doesn't change.

historial.vacioTitulo: You don't have any records yet
historial.vacioTexto: Once you do your first check-in, it will show up here.

bannerConexion.sinConexion: No connection. Your records are saved on the device and will be sent once you're back online.

campoTelefono.numeroPlaceholder: Your number, without the country code

selectorDesplegable.sinOpciones: No options available for this selection.

cambiarContrasenaObligatorio.subtitulo: Your administrator gave you a temporary password. Before continuing, choose a new one only you know.
cambiarContrasenaObligatorio.errorGenerico: We couldn't change the password. Check your connection and try again.

nuevaContrasena.confirmadaSinSesion: Your password was updated, but we couldn't open your session. Please log in with your email and your new password.
